matches.stipulation: Coin-toss replacement match after Buff Miller was ruled out with an injury
matches.note: Stryker and Tallion brawled to the outside and both were counted out; the match was ruled a draw.
Vars dominated the smaller Wilson from the bell and finished him with the inverted-piledriver "Vars Drop."
Both men traded high spots (a HeadHunter shooting star press, a Diego brainbuster) and fought the full twenty minutes to a time-limit draw.
"The Psychotic One" vowed to quit the promotion if he lost; Brian ambushed him before the bell and finished him with the double-arm DDT "Payback is hell."
GlacierIce out-wrestled the bigger Knuckles for most of the match and finished him with a jumping kick, the "Flying Chin Music."
Robinson rolled Shaw up and pulled a handful of tights behind the referee's back for the pin.

matches.note: HeadHunter had Hayes beaten when a masked Antonio Diego ran in, brainbustered HeadHunter on the outside and rolled him back in; Hayes covered for the pin with a top-rope splash.
Manager Monica slipped Milla a handful of blinding powder and faked a ringside injury to distract the referee; Shaw was disqualified after hitting Milla with a metal bar.
GlacierIce survived a late power-bomb and pump-handle slam flurry and finished Stryker with a jumping "Flying Chin Music" kick.
Vars nearly upset the much larger Maximus II with a moonsault and a suplex, but Maximus finished him with the claw slam "The Fall of Jupiter."

matches.stipulation: Tag team rematch after the Mischief Makers won the first meeting by disqualification
matches.note: With the referee down, Bobby Borden struck Tully Rascal with a chair to break up a pin; the Mischief Makers were disqualified and continued the beatdown after the bell.
The brawl spilled to the aisle and both men ignored the referee's ten count; the bout was ruled a double countout.
